about: Long-form compilation categories. Every Short in catalog.json gets exactly one `longformCategory` (the bundle it belongs to) and optionally `alsoFits` (other bundles it could join). Long-form videos are built per category from catalog.json, leaning on evergreen Shorts. Add a new category here only when a Short fits none of these.

categories.title: Animals & Nature
categories.covers: animal behaviour, plants, ecosystems, weird creatures

categories.title: Food & Kitchen Science
categories.covers: why food does what it does, cooking chemistry, kitchen myths

categories.title: Human Body & Health
categories.covers: how the body works, senses, sleep, health explained (not advice)

categories.title: Space & Planet Earth
categories.covers: astronomy, space missions, weather, volcanoes, oceans, geology

categories.title: History & Ancient Mysteries
categories.covers: past events, ancient tech, archaeology, origins of things

categories.title: Science, Tech & Engineering
categories.covers: physics, inventions, machines, technology, how things are built

categories.title: Everyday Mysteries
categories.covers: ordinary things with surprising explanations that fit nowhere above
